property_summary: After initializing the contract with feeRate = 5000, the reference allows it (since feeRate > 5000 is false) and feeRate stays 5000, while the bug reverts (since feeRate >= 5000 is true), so for the reference a subsequent call to availableForFlashLoan can be made without revert and feeRate is 5000, whereas the bug never reaches availableForFlashLoan because initialize reverts, leaving feeRate at its default 0.
change_summary: Change the condition from _feeRate > 5_000 to _feeRate >= 5_000 so that setting fee rate to exactly 5000 reverts.
